name: Yara Otal
occupation: Master Hunter / Woodcraft Specialist / Resource Processor
daily_routine: processing hides meat and forest resources
assisting logging teams with animal threats
teaching Fen survival and tracking skills
inspecting forest areas for resource viability

goals.public_goal: Provide stable food and material supply from the forest, maintain sustainable hunting practices, and prevent overuse of wildlife resources
goals.hidden_goal: Identify long-term animal migration shifts tied to forest changes
goals.deep_goal: Understand why certain animals behave unpredictably near specific forest zones

beliefs: The forest is structured, not random
Animal behavior can be learned like a language
Most danger comes from misunderstanding patterns, not from the forest itself
Resource waste is a greater threat than predators
The village underestimates how much the forest changes over time
